item.title: Psalm 23: The Shepherd and His Sheep
item.description: In the inaugural episode of Line by Line, host Rebecca establishes the covenantal and historical setting of David's most beloved psalm from a conservative Reformed perspective. Then, James walks line-by-line through the Hebrew text and classic commentaries of John Calvin, Matthew Henry, and Charles Spurgeon, unpacking Yahweh Rohi, the valley of the shadow of death, the prepared table, and the eternal security of Christ's flock.
